test_title: PYST 41: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 2nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

K _ H A _ A K O _ A R _ _ O H _ R A
solution:
Given : K _ H A _ A K O _ A R _ _ O H _ R A

By checking options :

 
• OHRAKA → K __**O**__ H A __**H**__ A K O __**R**__ A R __**A**__ __**K**__ O H __**A**__ R A → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• AOHRAK → K **__A__** H A **__O__** A K O **__H__** A R **__R__** **__A__** O H **__K__** R A → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• ORHAKA → K **__O__** H A **__R__** A K O **__H__** A R __A__ __K__ O H __A__ R A → (It follows the pattern of : KOHARA - KOHARA - KOHARA)
 
• OAHRKA → K __O__ H A **__A__** A K O **__H__** A R **__R__** __K__ O H __A__ R A → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (3) gives the pattern of " K __O__ H A __R__ A - K O __H__ A R __A__ - __K__ O H __A__ R A "

Hence, "**ORHAKA**" is the correct answer.
